column1: # ComputerBase — Counter-Strike 2 im Test: 22 Grafikkarten im CS:GO-Nachfolger im Benchmark.
# Imported 2026-10-17 for the "top played games" push: CS2 is the most-played
# game on Steam. Figures from each bar's data-value attribute via
# src/lib/perfEngine/computerbase.js (page 2's FHD, WQHD and UHD charts).
# Settings, from the article's own table: "Sehr-Hoch-Preset", 8x MSAA at
# 1.920 × 1.080 and 2.560 × 1.440, 4x MSAA at 3.840 × 2.160, native. The scene is
# a bot match on Ancient — CS2's most demanding map — with three grenade throws,
# so most matches run faster than these figures.
# NOT imported: GeForce RTX 3060 and Arc A770 (memory size not stated; the
# catalogue holds both variants of each), RX Vega 64 and RX 580 (no catalogue
# part), and the frametime chart (not a frame rate). The GTX 1060 FE is mapped to
# the 6 GB part because the Founders Edition only shipped as 6 GB.
title:     Counter-Strike 2 im Test: 22 Grafikkarten im CS:GO-Nachfolger im Benchmark
driver:    AMD Adrenalin 23.9.3 (23.9.2 on GCN); NVIDIA GeForce 537.42; Intel Arc 4826
scene:     Bot match on Ancient with HE, Molotov and smoke throws (described in the article)
